opening.argument: The speaker pairs recurring income claims with a direct invitation to join his team and start making money. He says, “we can start making money once a month,” claims he earns 100,000 a day, and says his team also made 25,000 every single day. He visibly holds multiple banknotes while a WhatsApp contact number is displayed, reinforcing the appeal to get in touch and join. This combination presents Forsage as an income opportunity built around team recruitment and earnings. The claimed amounts, any required payment, how the platform operates, and any resulting loss are not verified.

citations.quote: if you wish to be a part of my team you can connect with my number and join in our team so we can start making money once a month
It is a sad thing when I earn 100,000 a day, then my team is successful that's why I earn.
